mechanism: Gemfibrozil may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing eslicarbazepine exposure, while eslicarbazepine induces multiple CYP enzymes including CYP3A4, which may decrease gemfibrozil efficacy.
action: Monitor lipid levels and eslicarbazepine efficacy; consider alternative antilipemic agent or adjust gemfibrozil dosing; ensure adequate seizure control during concurrent use.
